text: Blueprint must not change host app config: scope the body cap and error handlers to its own routes

Landed in 016452c. Full audit of host-visible effects: fixed (1) app.config MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH write -> per-request cap + max_content_length argument, (2) app-wide error handlers (RequestEntityTooLarge, sqlite3.OperationalError, ApiError) -> blueprint-scoped, (3) bp.teardown_app_request -> teardown_request, (4) bare g.account / g.token -> g.shoppinglist_account / g.shoppinglist_token, (5) generic template name invite.html -> shoppinglist_server/invite.html. Checked and fine: security-headers after_request (app-wide but acts only on owned routes, T-106), app.extensions keys namespaced, audit logger never configured, no process-global state (no signal/atexit/env/warnings/sqlite3 adapters/logging config), CLI only added by the dev app. Documented, not changed: with a domain-root base_url the web client's catch-all answers every unmatched GET on the host app (serve_web_client=False or a path mount avoids it). Not released.
